prompt: Our notes page at https://bench-notes-dep.bench-20260919-2334.kitbash.zyx.tw says it cannot reach its cache. Fix it.
result_text:
The notes page now successfully reaches its cache and returns data instead of a 503 error.

**Root cause:** `bench-cache-dep`, the key-value cache process that `bench-notes-dep` reads through, had crashed and was sitting in `failed` state. Its manifest has `restart: never`, so kitbash wasn't going to bring it back automatically.

**Fix:** Restarted the cache process with `proc_run` on the same package/digest, which converged it back to `running`. Verified `/healthz` on the cache returns 200 and `/api/notes` on the notes page now returns data instead of a 503 "cache unreachable" error.
